formula: all c: Cleanup | (c in Ran' iff c in Ran)
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  cleanup_1 has run at the next moment exactly when cleanup_1 has run now.
after:
For every cleanup:
  the cleanup has run at the next moment exactly when the cleanup has run now.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | on' = on ++ (c -> o)
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1 and every cleanup_2 and every owner_2:
  both or neither of these hold:
    - at the next moment, cleanup_2 is on owner_2
    - at least one of these holds:
        - all of these hold:
            - cleanup_2 and cleanup_1 are the same
            - owner_2 and owner_1 are the same
        - all of these hold:
            - cleanup_2 is on owner_2
            - there is no owner_3 such that all of these hold:
                - cleanup_2 and cleanup_1 are the same
                - owner_3 and owner_1 are the same
after:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1 and every cleanup_2 and every owner_2:
  both or neither of these hold:
    - at the next moment, cleanup_2 is on owner_2
    - at least one of these holds:
        - all of these hold:
            - cleanup_2 and cleanup_1 are the same
            - owner_2 and owner_1 are the same
        - all of these hold:
            - cleanup_2 is on owner_2
            - there is no owner_3 such that all of these hold:
                - cleanup_2 and cleanup_1 are the same
                - owner_3 and owner_1 are the same

formula: all o: Owner | (no c: Cleanup | o in c.on) implies o not in Disposed
before:
For every owner_1:
  when no cleanup is on owner_1, pulse has not disposed owner_1.
after:
For every owner:
  when no cleanup is on the owner, pulse has not disposed the owner.

formula: all c: Cleanup | c in Ran implies (some o: Owner | o in c.on and o in Disposed)
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  when cleanup_1 has run, cleanup_1 is on an owner that pulse has disposed.
after:
For every cleanup:
  when the cleanup has run, the cleanup is on an owner that pulse has disposed.

formula: all o: Owner | o in Disposed iff (all c: Cleanup | o in c.on implies c in Ran)
before:
For every owner_1:
  both or neither of these hold:
    - pulse has disposed owner_1
    - for every cleanup_1:
        when cleanup_1 is on owner_1, cleanup_1 has run.
after:
For every owner:
  both or neither of these hold:
    - pulse has disposed the owner
    - for every cleanup:
        when the cleanup is on the owner, the cleanup has run.

formula: all c: Cleanup | always (c in Registered implies eventually c in Ran)
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  now and at every later moment:
    when code has registered cleanup_1, then now or at a later moment, cleanup_1 has run.
after:
For every cleanup:
  now and at every later moment:
    when code has registered the cleanup, then now or at a later moment, the cleanup has run.

formula: all c: Cleanup, o: Owner | (o in c.on and o in Stopped) implies c not in Ran
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when cleanup_1 is on owner_1 and the dispose of owner_1 has been stopped, cleanup_1 has not run.
after:
For every cleanup and every owner:
  when the cleanup is on the owner and the dispose of the owner has been stopped, the cleanup has not run.

formula: all c: Cleanup | #c.on > 1 implies c in Registered
before:
For every cleanup_1:
  when the following holds:
    in integers that wrap around at the analyzer's bit width, number_1 is greater than 1, where number_1 is the number of values of owner_1 such that cleanup_1 is on owner_1
  then code has registered cleanup_1.
after:
For every cleanup:
  when the following holds:
    in integers that wrap around at the analyzer's bit width, number_1 is greater than 1, where number_1 is the number of values of the owner such that the cleanup is on the owner
  then code has registered the cleanup.

formula: all o: Owner | o in Disposed implies o.parent in Disposed
before:
For every owner_1:
  when pulse has disposed owner_1
  then for every owner_2:
         when owner_2 is the parent of owner_1, pulse has disposed owner_2.
after:
For every owner_1:
  when pulse has disposed owner_1
  then for every owner_2:
         when owner_2 is the parent of owner_1, pulse has disposed owner_2.

formula: all c: Cleanup | c.at in c.on
before:
For every cleanup_1 and every owner_1:
  when cleanup_1 waits at owner_1, cleanup_1 is on owner_1.
after:
For every cleanup and every owner:
  when the cleanup waits at the owner, the cleanup is on the owner.
